newsitem.title: FRANCE: Worms soars on renewed Athena sale talk.
newsitem.headline: Worms soars on renewed Athena sale talk.

text.p: Shares in small French bank Worms et Cie rose sharply on Friday on the back of renewed market speculation that it could sell its 100 percent owned insurance unit Athena, dealers said.
The share was up 8.99 percent at 406 francs at 1533 GMT after rising as high as 416 francs in a market which was down overall.
"We've got an ever increasing feeling the Worms is going to sell Athena," said one trader.
Speculation on a sale has gathered pace again recently, since Axa and UAP decided to merge, a move read as heralding further restructuring in the sector.
Possible buyers most frequently cited are AGF, who have denied such a plan, and Allianz.
Worms was unable to provide an immediate comment when contacted.
